title: MCP: timeline_set_sound tool missing — cannot attach sound to keyframe
description: Added timeline_set_sound MCP tool. Schema: { layerId, frameIndex, libraryItemId (nullable), syncMode (event|start|stop|stream), repeatCount }. Handler looks up layerIndex from layerId, constructs SoundLinkage, and calls setSoundOnFrame from @flash/core. Registered in vite-plugin-agent-mcp/src/index.ts. All 575 authoring-ui tests pass. Committed in feat(0966) commit.
